diagnoses.bug: Snapshot and manifest verification parse each field before validating all digit bytes, so an invalid digit in a later field can be masked by an earlier Adler seed or parse error.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate every field’s syntax before parsing values or applying semantic checks, so errors follow the specified precedence.

diagnoses.bug: Malformed item structure is not fully checked before numeric parsing, so an earlier number error can mask the required InvalidSyntax at the item start.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate an input unit’s complete structure before interpreting its component values, so malformed syntax takes precedence over value errors.

diagnoses.bug: A stepped single number selects only that number because its end remains equal to its start; it should extend through the field maximum.
diagnoses.lesson: For each syntax form, derive its start and end bounds explicitly before applying a step, and verify that stepped and unstepped forms follow their distinct rules.

diagnoses.bug: The parser accepts a permitted name as a range endpoint but treats a name followed by a hyphen as a valid range even when the other endpoint is an invalid atom, then reports the endpoint error at that endpoint instead of InvalidSyntax at the item start.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate every token’s complete structure before converting values or reporting value-level errors; malformed syntax should take precedence over endpoint validation.

diagnoses.bug: The parser validates numeric values while still deciding whether an item has valid base syntax, so malformed bases can return numeric errors instead of InvalidSyntax at the item start.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate an input’s complete structure before interpreting values, so malformed syntax consistently takes precedence over semantic errors.

diagnoses.bug: A CR inside a quoted field is processed as literal data without first checking whether it begins CRLF, so a bare CR inside quotes is incorrectly accepted.
diagnoses.lesson: When parsing stateful formats, apply global byte-level validity checks before state-specific handling, including inside quoted or escaped regions.

diagnoses.bug: Dependency evidence records the path present when the edge is first emitted, so later discovery of a shorter canonical source path never updates that evidence path.
diagnoses.lesson: When derived data depends on a canonical fixed-point result, recompute it after convergence instead of retaining values from intermediate iterations.

diagnoses.bug: CFWS boundary checks use cleaned-byte indices as though they were run offsets, so runs after earlier removals can be misclassified.
diagnoses.lesson: When transforming input, keep source offsets and transformed indices distinct; validate boundaries against the coordinate system each rule defines.

diagnoses.bug: du computes totals for nested directories using already aggregated descendant directory sizes, so grandchildren are counted more than once.
diagnoses.lesson: When aggregating hierarchical data, ensure each underlying item contributes exactly once to every requested total.

diagnoses.bug: walk_items pops an active link after any target finishes, even when that target expanded another link, so nested targets can deactivate their caller and miss cycles.
diagnoses.lesson: Track recursive work with explicit completion frames; unwind each resource’s state only when its own work finishes.

diagnoses.bug: Link traversal never checks links in the starting directory components, so links inside cwd or home are not expanded before request traversal begins.
diagnoses.lesson: Apply traversal rules uniformly to initial state and later inputs; initialization must not bypass validation or event handling.

diagnoses.bug: The insertion sequence wraps after u64::MAX, so later jobs can receive lower sequence values and incorrectly win FIFO ties.
diagnoses.lesson: When a counter defines ordering, check its overflow behavior; wrapping can silently violate monotonicity and ordering guarantees.

diagnoses.bug: Failure propagation emits a skip line for every failed or blocked dependency, but each newly blocked job should emit exactly one line for a dependency that caused it to block.
diagnoses.lesson: When propagating a transitive condition, distinguish the affected item from the triggering causes and emit events at the granularity the specification requires.

diagnoses.bug: Arithmetic forms products in i128 before reduction, so valid operations can overflow an intermediate and panic in debug builds even when the reduced result fits.
diagnoses.lesson: Reduce operands by shared factors before multiplying, and use checked arithmetic when intermediates can exceed the chosen integer type.

diagnoses.bug: A `-` anywhere after byte 0 is reported at the current scan position, but a lone leading `-` with no numerator digit is also rejected immediately instead of validating the remaining bytes first, so later syntax violations can lose to an earlier missing-digit error.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate the complete input grammar before reporting missing-token errors, so later invalid bytes take precedence over magnitude and canonicality checks.

diagnoses.bug: Parsing arbitrarily long magnitudes can overflow `u128` during `num_mag * 10 + digit` or `mag * 10 + digit`, causing a panic instead of the required OutOfRange error.
diagnoses.lesson: When parsing unbounded digit sequences, check bounds before arithmetic so oversized input returns a defined error without overflowing the accumulator.

diagnoses.bug: When the first byte is `-` and no numerator digit follows, parsing reports InvalidByte at offset 1 instead of validating the full grammar and reporting the missing digit at text.len().
diagnoses.lesson: For parsers with positional errors, distinguish invalid bytes from missing required tokens and report each at its specified byte offset.

diagnoses.bug: The prerelease admission condition simplifies to true for every candidate, so prereleases match without an anchor in their arm.
diagnoses.lesson: Translate policy conditions into explicit predicates, then check each truth case to catch branches that accidentally make a restriction unconditional.

diagnoses.bug: tuple_pre_witness checks only the least prerelease and immediate successors of explicit bounds, so it misses witnesses strictly between bounds, such as `>1.0.0-alpha <1.0.0-beta` satisfied by `1.0.0-alpha.0`.
diagnoses.lesson: When reasoning about ordered values, account for every possible interval witness, including discrete successors and gaps; checking only endpoints can miss valid interior values.

diagnoses.bug: Hyphen ranges accept a three-field partial upper endpoint such as `1 - 2.3.4.x` incorrectly as a closed bound at 2.3.4, instead of rejecting the malformed partial.
diagnoses.lesson: Validate parsed operand shape before expanding it; distinguish explicit field count from numeric field count when wildcards are present.

diagnoses.bug: An exploded empty List is handled correctly, but a non-exploded List with one empty item is emitted as an empty field; the required field is still present and must trigger the operator prefix.
diagnoses.lesson: Track whether a value contributes fields separately from whether its rendered text is empty; empty fields can still affect separators and prefixes.

diagnoses.bug: decode_many calls Vec::with_capacity(count), which can panic for an enormous count before decoding input or returning a truncation error.
diagnoses.lesson: Avoid allocating directly from untrusted size parameters; grow storage only as validated input justifies it.

diagnoses.bug: StreamDecoder::push increments position with unchecked addition, so a committed stream at usize::MAX can overflow and panic or wrap instead of returning safely.
diagnoses.lesson: Check arithmetic at numeric boundaries before mutating state, and preserve the operation’s atomicity when a boundary is exceeded.

lessons: Validate complete syntax and grammar before parsing values or applying semantic checks, so malformed input takes precedence according to specified error positions.
Derive bounds and explicit structure before applying transformations or expansion; distinguish source coordinates, field counts, and empty values from rendered text.
Check arithmetic and allocation boundaries before mutation or allocation; use checked operations and preserve atomicity when limits are exceeded.
Recompute derived data from the final converged state instead of retaining intermediate results.
Apply validation and traversal rules uniformly to initial and later inputs, including bytes inside quoted or escaped regions.
Track recursive work with explicit completion state, and unwind each resource only after its own work finishes.
Ensure each underlying item contributes exactly once to aggregates, and emit propagated events at the specified granularity.
Translate policies and ordering requirements into explicit predicates; account for all valid interval witnesses and prevent counter overflow from violating guarantees.
